svg.title: Three connected worlds: languages, AI and Agentic AI Engineering
svg.desc: Three horizontal orbital charts with measured source-byte and repository-topic arcs. Labels show raw bytes or repository counts, without percentage labels. Engineering stack and agentic workflow categories are combined, retaining all sixteen topics. Counts describe documented portfolio evidence, not proficiency. Source capture: 14 November 2026; curated: 15 November 2026. Orbit highlights and dotted routes are decorative; reduced motion is supported.
svg.text: Arcs show source bytes or documented topic matches. A repository can appear in several topics.
